generatedProse.practice-connection:
From here, creativity is something you practise in every module. Each time you generate several options before choosing one, each unexpected link you draw between ideas, and each rough draft you let develop, is the skill at work. It is also what study and professional practice reward: finding fresh angles and turning them into questions and plans you can act on.

None of this depends on a special talent. It depends on habits you can keep: making room for rough ideas, holding judgement back until there is something to judge, and following a connection to see where it leads.
